title: Creator Tools
description: Add creative camera controls, walk mode and weather toggles for cinematic gameplay and creative recording.
body:
# Creator Tools 

![Dutch Angle Active](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd0cdb840260d1436b28e20b1620ff2dd8c933e9.jpeg)

This mod adds advanced camera controls to Minecraft and more,  it is a small cinematography toolkit and creative mode hub.

Main features:

Advanced camera controls: start/stop engine, tripod, orbit, zoom in/out, preset shots, and page-based film framing

Camera views: front, overhead, side, over-shoulder, follow (third-person variants), wide/closeup, low/high angle, dutch tilt, etc.

Cinematic shot paging and quick selection for smooth scene composition

Walk mode (slow walk and smooth camera movement)

Weather control buttons to switch clear/rain and environment states instantly

Automation sequences: auto details, auto random, auto scene

No unfair multiplayer advantages; no combat cheats or gameplay hacks

No external data upload; local, client-side only

- Toggle Walkmode "C"
- Toggle Painel "P"
- Toggle Api on/off Save State "O"
- Set Rain "1 Numpad"
- Set Clear "2 Numpad"
